controls.class_matched_non_target: score argmax over queries whose dominant-overlap physical instance is a declared same-class peer of the target; null and no fallback when the pool is empty
controls.class_matched_selector: score argmax over queries whose dominant-overlap physical instance has the target class; target and non-target instances are both allowed; null and no fallback when the pool is empty
controls.deployed: score argmax over all queries; lowest index wins ties

dominant_overlap.instance: argmax overlap count between the query mask and physical instance labels; lowest instance ID wins ties

score_matched_pair.tie_break: minimum absolute score difference, then SHA256 of contract and query pair, then positive index, then negative index
score_matched_pair.unavailable_policy: row excluded from paired estimand; no fallback

controls.target_objectness: score argmax over queries whose FPS seed lies in the target instance union; null and no fallback when the pool is empty
controls.target_positive: score argmax over queries whose mask is a native training positive; null and no fallback when the pool is empty
controls.unknown_semantics: use the frozen manifest object_id-to-class map; sampled semantic label -100 never substitutes for native annotation class

primary_estimand.aggregation: compute the paired mean within each scene, then average scene means
primary_estimand.name: scene_balanced_paired_target_iou_uplift

rejection_criteria: reject identity-specific causal support when complete pairs are below 64
reject identity-specific causal support when independent scenes are below 64
reject identity-specific causal support when the paired point estimate is below 0.05
reject identity-specific causal support when the scene bootstrap lower bound is not above zero
report secondary controls as descriptive when class_matched_selector or target_objectness is unavailable
never treat this diagnostic as admission, efficacy, population, novelty, or deployable evidence

strata.ambiguous: target has at least one same-class non-target object_id in the scene
strata.class_unique: target is the only object_id with that ScanRefer object_name in the scene
